description: This file defines a class 'StatsCollectorGrain' which implements the 'IStatsCollectorGrain' interface. The class is used within the Orleans framework to collect statistics by counting method calls.

classes.name: StatsCollectorGrain
classes.description: A grain class in Orleans that collects statistics related to method call counts, with placement preference annotations.

methods.name: ReportStatsCalled
methods.description: Increments the call counter for reporting stats and returns a completed task.

methods.name: GetReportStatsCallCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times 'ReportStatsCalled' has been called.
